title: Library
intro: Writing and recordings on SHRDLU, from 1971 onward: articles, books, chapters, theses, news items, web pages, talks and films. A copy is held here where the work has an open licence or is in the public domain; otherwise the entry links to where it is published. Gathered in November 2026 from indexes, full-text searches and catalogues. Many publishers' sites and some repositories could not be searched, so the list is incomplete.

SHRDLU: printed pp. 203, 208, 209 (index line); text from Internet Archive full-text passages.

items.author: Friedenberg, Jay

items.author: Goh, Ong

items.title: The psychology of language: from data to theory

SHRDLU: printed pp. 14-15 (index line); text from Internet Archive full-text passages.

items.title: Inconsistency Robustness for Logic Programs

He also describes its theorem format in Planner (THGOAL, THASSERT, THERASE). SHRDLU: Section 3.1 "SHRDLU", printed pp. 41-47 (PDF pp. 51-57); contents PDF p. 5. items.author: Raynor, William J., Jr
